2026-11-02.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
2026-11-02.reflection: God's love came first, and it is big enough for everyone.

2026-11-03.text: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
2026-11-03.reflection: A good shepherd knows what his sheep need before they ask.

2026-11-04.text: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don't lean on your own understanding.
2026-11-04.reflection: Trust God even when you cannot see the whole picture.

2026-11-05.text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
2026-11-05.reflection: Turn one worry into a prayer, and add a thank-you to it.

2026-11-06.text: Don't you be afraid, for I am with you. Don't be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
2026-11-06.reflection: You are held, even on the days you feel weak.

2026-11-07.text: Haven't I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don't be afraid. Don't be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.
2026-11-07.reflection: Courage grows when we remember who goes with us.

2026-11-08.text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
2026-11-08.reflection: God can weave even hard days into something good.

2026-11-09.text: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
2026-11-09.reflection: Jesus invites the tired, not the perfect.

2026-11-10.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
2026-11-10.reflection: Help is not far away; it is present right now.

2026-11-11.text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
2026-11-11.reflection: Justice, mercy and humility: three ways to walk with God today.

2026-11-12.text: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
2026-11-12.reflection: Let the good you do point people toward God.

2026-11-13.text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
2026-11-13.reflection: Jesus' peace is a gift, not something we have to earn.

2026-11-14.text: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
2026-11-14.reflection: Look for one sign of God's goodness in your day.

2026-11-15.text: For God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
2026-11-15.reflection: Fear is not the voice of God; love and courage are.

2026-11-16.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
2026-11-16.reflection: God's word often shows the next step, not the whole road.

2026-11-17.text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
2026-11-17.reflection: Faith trusts God even before we see the outcome.

2026-11-18.text: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn't envy. Love doesn't brag, is not proud,

2026-11-19.text: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
2026-11-19.reflection: Help carry someone else's burden today.

2026-11-20.text: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
2026-11-20.reflection: Be kind and forgive, as God has forgiven you.

2026-11-21.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
2026-11-21.reflection: Every good gift comes from God.

2026-11-22.text: Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don't forget all his benefits,
2026-11-22.reflection: Count the good things God has done; don't forget one.

2026-11-23.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
2026-11-23.reflection: Come to God with thanks before you come with requests.

2026-11-24.text: Shout for joy to Yahweh, all you lands!
2026-11-24.reflection: Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth!

2026-11-25.text: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
2026-11-25.reflection: Give thanks today: his love never runs out.

2026-11-26.text: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
2026-11-26.reflection: Find something to thank God for in every situation.

2026-11-27.text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
2026-11-27.reflection: Gratitude begins with remembering that God is good.

2026-11-28.text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
2026-11-28.reflection: Let Christ's peace rule in your heart, and be thankful.

2026-11-29.text: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.
2026-11-29.reflection: A great light has come to people walking in darkness.

2026-11-30.text: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
2026-11-30.reflection: Waiting for God can be full of hope.

2026-12-01.text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
2026-12-01.reflection: Hope is something God pours in, not something we squeeze out.

2026-12-02.text: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
2026-12-02.reflection: Waiting on God is not wasted time; it is where strength is renewed.

2026-12-03.text: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
2026-12-03.reflection: From an old stump, God brought new life.

2026-12-04.text: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

2026-12-05.text: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
2026-12-05.reflection: God chose little Bethlehem for the greatest birth.

2026-12-06.text: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
2026-12-06.reflection: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Prince of Peace: what a name!

2026-12-07.text: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
2026-12-07.reflection: Imagine God rejoicing over you with singing.

2026-12-08.text: Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh's glory has risen on you.
2026-12-08.reflection: Arise and shine; the light has come.

2026-12-09.text: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
2026-12-09.reflection: At just the right time, God sent his Son.

2026-12-10.text: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.

2026-12-11.text: Mary said, "Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word." The angel departed from her.
2026-12-11.reflection: Mary's yes to God changed the world.

2026-12-12.text: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
2026-12-12.reflection: Make a joyful noise to the Lord!

2026-12-13.text: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
2026-12-13.reflection: Let your spirit rejoice in God your Saviour.

2026-12-14.text: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.

2026-12-15.text: "Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel;" which is, being interpreted, "God with us."
2026-12-15.reflection: Christmas means God came to be with us.

2026-12-16.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
2026-12-16.reflection: Jesus, the Word, was there from the very beginning.

2026-12-17.text: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
2026-12-17.reflection: In Jesus is life, and that life is light.

2026-12-18.text: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn't overcome it.
2026-12-18.reflection: Darkness has never been able to put out God's light.

2026-12-19.text: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
2026-12-19.reflection: God came close and lived among us.

2026-12-20.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
2026-12-20.reflection: God's grace has appeared, bringing salvation to all.

2026-12-21.text: By this God's love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.
2026-12-21.reflection: God showed his love by sending his Son.

2026-12-22.text: "Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him."
2026-12-22.reflection: The wise men followed a star to find a King.

2026-12-23.text: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.
2026-12-23.reflection: The sign was simple: a baby wrapped in cloth.

2026-12-24.text: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.
2026-12-24.reflection: The King of kings was laid in a manger.

2026-12-25.text: For there is born to you today, in David's city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
2026-12-25.reflection: A Saviour was born: Christ the Lord.

2026-12-26.text: "Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men."
2026-12-26.reflection: Glory to God, and peace on earth.

2026-12-27.text: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, "Let's go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us."
2026-12-27.reflection: Like the shepherds, go and see what God has done.

2026-12-28.text: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
2026-12-28.reflection: Like Mary, treasure what God is doing and think about it.

2026-12-29.text: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.
2026-12-29.reflection: The shepherds went back praising God. What will you praise him for?

2026-12-30.text: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
2026-12-30.reflection: The wise men rejoiced with great joy. So can we.

2026-12-31.text: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
2026-12-31.reflection: Every morning brings fresh mercy. Great is his faithfulness!
